title: Golod--Shafarevich for arithmetic surfaces
summary: We construct Golod--Shafarevich towers of arithmetic surfaces over the integers. In particular, we obtain an arithmetic surface with a section and infinite geometric etale fundamental group, answering a question raised by Bost and Charles about the existence of such surfaces. Taking generic fibres gives curves over the rationals with infinite geometric etale towers in which a rational point splits completely.
